ammonia.reason: Measured 1760 mg/kg NH3 from urea catabolism and deamination during smear ripening.

animal_barnyard.reason: Brevibacterium linens proteolysis yielding p-cresol/indole at rind.

bitter.reason: Limited hydrophobic peptides due to short 30-d age and moderate salt 1.47%.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti and no methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone.

browning.reason: Glutamate/lysine plus fat support Maillard when baked for tartiflette.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Streptococcus thermophilus plus rich milkfat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic plus 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and Leu catabolism by smear flora.

creaminess.reason: Fat 25.1%, FDM ~52% plus rind deacidification to pH 6.8 gives creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-coagulated pressed curd with Ca solubilization retains cohesive smooth paste.

firmness.reason: High moisture 53.5% and smear proteolysis soften paste to supple pressed body.

floral_honey.reason: Phe catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol by yeasts.

fruity.reason: Yeast Geotrichum/Debaryomyces esterification to ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk contains no caprine branched C8 acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from Leu/Ile give hazelnut note.

melt.reason: pH 5.87 demineralized paracasein plus high fat/moisture allows excellent flow.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil from 25% fat coalescence on heating without emulsion failure.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: Low residual lactic acid at pH 5.87 with early acetate 0.26 g/kg mostly metabolized.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading so no aligned paracasein fibers to pull.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd with minimal whey-protein denaturation so low H2S/DMS.

sweet.reason: Galactose exhausted by day 20 leaving only slight milkfat-lactone sweetness.

umami.reason: Measured 2.3 g/kg glutamate on day 35 from rennet/plasmin proteolysis.
